doc: stages/writers.copc.rst, 'VLRs' section: 'VLRs can be created by providing a JSON node called `vlrs` with objects as shown ... One of `data`, `filename` or `metadata` must be specified. Data must be specified as base64 encoded strings.' The page's own example VLR (user_id hobu, record_id 42, data dGhpcyBpcyBzb21lIHRleHQ=) is written and read back. VLR/EVLR block placement is an implementation choice not stated by the page and is not asserted; the payload 'this is some text' (the base64-decoded value) is asserted by content search. The same case covers the `pipeline` option ('Emit a JSON-representation of the pipeline as a VLR'); the pipeline JSON content is asserted without pinning the block or the user_id/record_id, which are not stated in the shipped corpus.
